name: start_audit_session
description:
Audit the calling MCP agent. Heron asks 9+ compliance questions about what the agent does, what data it touches, and what permissions it holds. The response includes a `status` field that tells the caller which interview mode is active:
- `interviewing`: the client declared MCP sampling capability. Heron will ask each question via sampling/createMessage in the background. The caller can poll progress via get_report or watch the dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:3700/dashboard/sessions/<id>.
- `awaiting_answer`: the client does not support sampling (e.g. Codex CLI / Codex.app). The response includes the first question under `next_question`. The caller MUST reply by calling submit_answer with the returned session_id plus an answer string. Each submit_answer returns either the next question (status=awaiting_answer) or the final report (status=complete).

agent_name.description: Optional human-readable name for the audited agent.

name: submit_answer
description: Provide the next answer to an in-progress Heron audit interview started via start_audit_session. Returns either the next question (status=awaiting_answer) or the final report (status=complete) once all questions have been answered. Always pair with start_audit_session — this tool is only callable when an audit session is in the 'awaiting_answer' state (non-sampling clients, AAP-55).

session_id.description: The session id returned by a prior start_audit_session call.

answer.description: The agent’s answer to the most recently asked question.

name: start_verification
description:
Scan agent's runtime environment for evidence supporting the audit transcript.

Reads:
  - MCP server configurations from runtime configs
  - Plugin / skill / auth credential NAMES (never values)
  - macOS Keychain service names matching AI/SaaS allowlist (opt-in)
  - Cross-cutting OS credential file identifiers (AWS, GCP, kube, npm, ...)
  - Environment variable NAMES from workspace .env files

NEVER reads:
  - Actual credential values, tokens, passwords
  - Files outside the standard discovery paths

Output: deterministic evidence to verify the agent's declared scope.

session_id.description: The session id returned by a prior start_audit_session call. Must reference a session whose interview has completed (status complete or analysis_failed).

workspace_hint.description: Optional absolute workspace path the verification scan should target. When omitted, Heron uses the workspace path the MCP client advertised at session start, falling back to the server process cwd.

name: get_report
description: Retrieve a previously-generated Heron audit report by its id.

report_id.description: The session id returned by a prior start_audit_session call.

name: compare_reports
description: Compare two Heron audit reports by id and return a markdown diff highlighting what was resolved, what changed, and what was added between the two audits.
